display_title: The Count's Daughter and the Handmaid

titles_en.title: The Count's Daughter and the Handmaid
The Earl's Daughter and the Maidservant

description:
Um, the only daughter of a count, was born as Arena's handmaid.  
'If I recite a spell, the lady can get what she wants.'  
An accidental favor given only once, and a body swapped with that of the owner.  
‘Remember, kind maid. Magic like a dream only lasts for one year.'  
Um became the countess's daughter in an instant!  
However, Arena was scheduled to be engaged... … .  
"I've changed my mind, Lady Kreum."  
Allod clasped Oum's hand and smiled, widening his eyes. Goosebumps ran down her spine. Even though I knew that the owner of that smile wasn't me.  
“It’s okay if we continue until marriage.”  
The breath in front of his nose, like a whisper, hardened his grip. As she twisted, Arrod wrapped herself around Um's waist.  
The next moment, Um's face turned white.  
***  
The time given is only 1 year!  
You must get out of here.
